recipes.name: Crunchy Pecan & Cranberry Granola
instructions: Line a baking tray and preheat the oven to 325°F (160°C)*.
Add the dry in gredients to a large bowl. Mix well.
In a separate small bowl, whisk together the wet ingredients. Pour this over the dry ingredients and mix, then spread out over the baking tray.
Bake for 25 to 35 minutes, until lightly golden. Stir once or twice throughout. When removed from the oven, add the dried fruit and chia seeds.
When fully cooled, transfer to a large glass storage jar. Enjoy with yogurt and fruit for breakfast or as a snack!

page_recipe_notes: Notes * We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection).
Storage Store sealed and on the counter for up to 3 weeks.
